dropzone.prompt: Drop EPUB files here, or <browse>click to browse</browse>
dropzone.processingHint: Extracting chapters and reading metadata — usually a few seconds per book.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Clean watermarks from your EPUB library.

error.noProviders: No authentication providers are enabled. Configure password or OIDC on the server.

setup.title: Set up your instance
setup.subtitle: Create the administrator account to get started. You can add more users afterward.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Upload EPUB files. Open a book in the library to edit it and run the AI cleanup when ready.
dashboard.scanModeDescription: Pattern mode sends only the context surrounding each match; full-page sends every page.
dashboard.noBooks: No books yet. Drop a book above to start.
dashboard.settingsWarning: Add an API key and model on the <1>Settings page</1> before uploading.
dashboard.dropHint: Drop EPUB files here, or click to browse
dashboard.dropMeta: EPUB only · multiple files · max 200 MB each

books.title: Library
books.subtitle: Every book you've uploaded. Click a row to open the editor.

bookDetail.dropHint: Re-copy the cleaned file to the drop folder configured in Settings.
bookDetail.cancelConfirm: Stop the AI run? Any in-flight chapter calls will be dropped. Already-applied proposals stay in the editor for review.
bookDetail.parallelHint: Concurrent LLM requests for this book (set when the AI run starts).

review.repromptChapterHint: Re-run the LLM on this entire page; new items appear as Pending.
review.finalizeHint: Apply every accepted change and write the cleaned EPUB.
review.finalizeAndDownloadHint: Apply accepted changes, write the cleaned EPUB, and download it.
review.cloneHint: Make a copy of this book's cleaned output as a new entry — open it and click Run AI to do another pass.
review.rerunHint: Re-run the LLM on this file. New findings appear as Pending; your existing accept/reject decisions are preserved.
review.awaitingBanner: This file stopped after the LLM pass so you can review each proposed removal. The original EPUB is unchanged until you click Finalize.

settings.title: Settings

empty.title: No personal preferences yet.
empty.subtitle: There's nothing to configure here right now — future personal settings will appear on this page.

aiFeature.title: AI features
aiFeature.subtitle: Master switch for the LLM cleanup feature. Off hides Run-AI buttons throughout the app.
aiFeature.toggleHint: When off, users see the editor + library + drop folder, but no "Run AI" or "Add & run AI" controls.

userPrompt.subtitle: The admin's instructions are layered first; whatever you add here is appended at every AI call.
userPrompt.title: Your additions
userPrompt.placeholder: e.g. "This book is in French — keep punctuation untouched."
userPrompt.hint: Sent verbatim after the admin's prompt. Leave empty to use the admin's instructions only.

settings.readOnlyHint: These settings are managed by an administrator. Ask an admin to change them.

scopes.appHint: Shared by everyone on this instance. The LLM credentials, system prompt, parallel-request budget, and drop folder live here.
scopes.userHint: Just for you — your default scan mode, context window, and trigger patterns.

llm.title: LLM provider
llm.subtitle: Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.
llm.apiKeySet: Already set — leave blank to keep

scanning.title: Scanning
scanning.subtitle: Defaults for new jobs (still overridable per-upload).
scanning.contextWindowHint: Only applies in Pattern mode — characters of context kept around each match. Ignored in Full-page mode (the whole page is sent).
scanning.parallelRequestsHint: Global cap on concurrent LLM calls across every running book. Books share the same pool, so two books processing at once compete for the same slots — this is total in-flight, not per-book. Changes apply on next restart.
scanning.reviewBeforeApplyingLabel: Pause for review after the LLM pass
scanning.reviewBeforeApplyingHint: When enabled, the cleaned EPUB is not written until you accept or reject each proposed removal. The original file is never touched while reviewing.

prompt.title: System prompt
prompt.subtitle: The output format is fixed to ensure valid JSON. You can add extra instructions below.
prompt.additionalHint: Optional. Appended to the base prompt on every AI run.
prompt.additionalPlaceholder: Add any extra guidance for the LLM…
prompt.hasAdditions: Custom instructions active — will be appended to the base prompt.

dropFolder.title: Drop folder
dropFolder.subtitle: Auto-copy each cleaned EPUB to this folder when the job finishes.
dropFolder.label: Folder path
dropFolder.hint: Absolute path on the server. Leave blank to disable. The folder is created if it doesn't exist; existing files are never overwritten.

patterns.title: Trigger patterns
patterns.subtitle: Regex or plain-text. Files matching any pattern are sent to the LLM.

sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: OPDS catalogs you've connected — Calibre, Standard Ebooks, your private bookshelf.
sources.none: No sources yet. Add an OPDS catalog URL to start importing books.

modal.name: Name
modal.defaultMode: Default action when adding a book
modal.modeAddOnlyHint: Just imports the file. You decide when to run the AI from the editor.
modal.modeAddAndRunAiHint: Imports and immediately queues the AI cleanup pass.

adminUsage.title: Active processing
adminUsage.subtitle: Every book the worker is currently processing across all users. Pause, resume or stop a run from here.
adminUsage.empty: No books are running, queued or paused right now.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Provision local accounts. OIDC-provisioned users appear here once they sign in.

editor.openHint: Open the page editor (edit, see diff, commit).
editor.noPages: No pages yet — editor initializes on the first run.
editor.selectAPage: Select a page on the left.
editor.previewCurrentHint: Render the current working tree (your edits + AI proposals).
editor.previewDiffHint: Side-by-side: removed paragraphs in red strikethrough, added ones in green. Typography is simplified.
editor.discardHint: Throw away every uncommitted change on this page.
editor.acceptHunkHint: Commit this change only — keep every other pending change as-is.
editor.rejectHunkHint: Discard this change only — keep every other pending change as-is.
editor.acceptPageHint: Commit every change on this page in one go.
editor.acceptSelectedHint: Commit every pending change on the checked pages.
editor.acceptSelectedFailed: Could not accept the selected pages
editor.partialBadge: Partial AI run — {{n}} item(s) couldn't be matched.
editor.partialBanner: The last AI pass had {{n}} proposed removal(s) that couldn't be matched verbatim — review this chapter manually.
editor.historyHint: See every commit that touched this page and roll back to any of them.
editor.historyEmpty: No history yet for this page.
editor.historyPreviewHint: Show this revision's content inline before deciding whether to restore.
editor.historyRestoreHint: Drop this revision into the working tree as a pending change you can review.
editor.historyRestoreConfirm: Replace the current page with this revision? It lands as a pending change you can still accept or reject.
editor.rejectSelectedHint: Discard every pending change on the checked pages.
editor.rejectSelectedConfirm: Discard every pending change on the {{n}} checked page(s)? This cannot be undone.
editor.rejectSelectedFailed: Could not reject the selected pages
editor.runAiHint: Send the selected pages to the LLM for cleanup.
editor.runAiFailed: Could not start the AI run
editor.logsClearHint: Clear the displayed log lines (server history is unaffected).
editor.metadataHint: Edit the EPUB title, author, language, publisher and description. Saved into the EPUB so the next download carries the changes.
editor.bookPromptHint: Layered after the admin and user prompts. Use this for book-specific guidance — e.g. "this book is in French", "keep all em-dashes", "the watermark always reads 'demo edition'".
editor.bookPromptPlaceholder: e.g. "This is a fantasy book — keep made-up names like Aerysse, Kael, Ven'thara untouched."
editor.resetHint: Wipe the editor repo and re-extract every page from the original EPUB. Use after an upgrade so existing books pick up extraction-pipeline fixes (paragraph breaks, chapter ordering).
editor.resetConfirm: Re-extract every page from the original EPUB? Any uncommitted edits and committed history will be lost.
